target_ecosystem: Tollstile (tollstile.com) — an open-source runtime that adds a payment rail to agent tools (402 challenge, settlement, ledger, reconciliation) across HTTP and MCP. Its official rails settle in stablecoins/cards on Base/Solana. It is an agent-payments ecosystem with no Nano support today.
target_audience: maintainers and operators of Tollstile-based agent tools and MCP servers who want a second, zero-fee, instant-finality settlement rail beside their stablecoin rail.
why_nano_missing: Tollstile's official rails are stablecoin/card-only (Base/Solana USDC); no Nano (XNO) rail exists in its rail ecosystem, so an agent tool on Tollstile cannot settle feeless today.
novelty: No Nano rail exists for the Tollstile runtime. This is exactly the integration the Tollstile maintainer (Yosh102, tollstile/Tollstile#44) invited: 'a Nano rail is a natural community rail — a package named tollstile-rail-nano, keyword tollstile-rail, tollstile as a peer dependency, no core changes needed.' It is a thin adapter over existing Nano libraries, never a rebuild of payment internals.
reuses_existing_nano_tools: nanocurrency-js (npm) for Nano address/block primitives and proof-of-work
rpc.nano.to public Nano RPC (block_info) for on-chain confirmation, reusing the same evidence as the x402 exact-scheme work (block E67FB894...)
tollstile createRail() framework as the integration surface (the rail itself is a thin adapter over the two Nano primitives above)
deliverable: A published npm package tollstile-rail-nano (PANDeveloper001 account) that passes the Tollstile railConformance() suite against a fake Nano RPC provider, with README stating pass/skip, then a rail listing issue opened upstream on tollstile/Tollstile.
